Israel , Merkaz Area, Tel Aviv, Ra’anana Equity Analyst - SDR We are seeking a highly motivated and driven Equity Analyst/Business Developer to join our team as a Sales Development Representative (SDR) . This role is ideal for someone with 1-2 years of experience in Venture Capital, Finance, or related fields, particularly in startups, and who is eager to excel in a fast-paced environment . You will be pivotal in building and expanding Aption’s client base by identifying and engaging founders, executives, and early employees in the startup ecosystem. This role requires a smart, analytical, and hungry individual with a passion for understanding venture capital markets and the unique financial needs of startup professionals. The ideal candidate thrives in an outbound-focused, process-driven role and is eager to make a significant impact.
